costSaverAuto.label: Cost-saver turns on by itself
costSaverAuto.help: Turns the cost-saver mode on when this month's AI spend reaches 80% of the AI ceiling. Off as shipped.

digest.label: AI daily digest
digest.help: One daily summary of what waits for the owner, what the agents did and what the AI cost. Off as shipped.

offText.label: Text shown while AI is off
offText.help: The line staff and the shop see while AI is off, in English and Bengali. Empty means the built-in words.

trainingOff.label: Corrections and documents switched off
trainingOff.help: Ids of the training corrections and documents the owner stopped using. Nothing is deleted.

keepOnFeatures.label: Checks that keep running while AI is off
keepOnFeatures.help: Which cheap system checks (site health, backup, courier score, stuck parcels, daily digest, reply drafts) keep running while AI is off. They never call an AI model: anything that would stops when AI is off.

control.label: Telegram control
control.help: Daily report time, weekly audit, alert switches, the big-order line and the allowed Telegram accounts. All off or empty as shipped.

settlement.label: Where the money lands
settlement.help: The account each way of paying settles into, and how many working days it takes. Empty as shipped.
